title: The review of Phase H's last packages: answers, briefs and exports no longer reach Home's model, and Home works on pandas 3
request: Review the current repo, make sure everything is fine, and get the latest update.
spec: An independent review of the commits from H7a to the head of main (H7a to H12, 35.8, H3.1), each finding checked by running it; the findings that are defects fixed with a test that fails before the fix.
plan: Fast-forward main to the remote, run the R&D gates and the suite.
Have an independent reviewer read H7a..HEAD for privacy, leakage, behaviour and process breaks.
Fix what was confirmed, each with a test, and report what is the owner's to decide.

decisions.decision: The model reads an answer, a decision brief or an export as what was computed, never its values (model_text).
decisions.why: home_agent is shown no cell values and its prompts are kept whole for training; the tools' clean return values were undone by the chat history.

decisions.decision: Text columns are found with dclab_core.times.is_text in the new Home code.
decisions.why: The requirements allow pandas 3, where text is the string type: the business brief, the model's compare tool, the prepare step's value lookup and the spreadsheet formula guard all skipped every text column.

decisions.decision: 35.8 v2's missing devlog record, the H3.1 Team-panel question, the unused exposure log and H3.1 keeping columns on the reviewer's words are reported to the owner, not changed.
decisions.why: Each is a design choice or another package's record that this review cannot write faithfully.

change: dclab_rnd/home_query.py model_text(plan); dclab_rnd/draft/chat.py: the answer, the decision brief and export_data carry model_text, the compare tool uses is_text; dclab_rnd/draft/business.py: the year of the period asked about when only the baseline has one, is_text; dclab_rnd/draft/prepare.py: is_text in the value lookup and the formula guard. Tests in test_model_data_limits, test_home_answer, test_home_business, test_home_prepare. dclab_core/query.py and contracts.py: the import order (0.131.1, CHANGELOG, data catalog); tests/test_agents_runtime.py: the draft tools.

findings.defect: An answer's group names and totals reached home_agent's next prompt.
findings.scenario: query_data grouped by city: the tool returned only its id, but the next turn's history held every city with its total and the count of hidden groups, and the prompt was kept for training.
findings.cause: The answer was said without model_text, and memory.recent reads model_text or the text.
findings.fix: The answer message carries model_text: the operation, the columns and the period, never a value or a count.
findings.test: test_home_agent_sees_no_value_of_an_answer_it_asked_for (19 cell values before the fix, none after), test_the_models_history_holds_what_was_computed_never_a_value

findings.defect: A decision brief's totals and segments reached home_agent's history.
findings.scenario: A business question about revenue between two months: the brief with its totals and region names was the next prompt's history.
findings.cause: The same: the brief message had no model_text.
findings.fix: model_text names the measure, the two periods and the split column only.

findings.defect: export_data told the model the row count after a filter it chose.
findings.scenario: Filter, export, undo, filter with the next value: each count in the history narrows one row's value.
findings.cause: The export message had no model_text.

findings.defect: The period asked about was the wrong year when only the baseline named one.
findings.scenario: Why did revenue fall in January compared with December 2025 compared January 2025 with December 2025.
findings.cause: Only a missing baseline year was moved; the mirror case was not handled.
findings.fix: A month without its year that comes before the baseline's month is in the year after.

findings.defect: On pandas 3 the business brief never ran and the formula guard skipped every text cell.
findings.scenario: The suite on pandas 3.0.2: every business-brief test failed with no column to split by; a cell starting with = was exported unchanged.
findings.cause: dtype == object finds no text column on pandas 3, where text is the string type.
findings.fix: dclab_core.times.is_text in business.py, prepare.py and the compare tool.

findings.defect: from dclab_core import query as a program's first import raised ImportError.
findings.scenario: test_home_chart, test_home_query, test_home_notebook and test_core_query failed when run on their own; a host importing the query engine first could not load it.
findings.cause: contracts imported query while query was still loading, then recipe, whose from dclab_core.query import Filter found no Filter yet.
findings.fix: query imports recipe, change and dashboard at its end; contracts imports query only (dclab-core 0.131.1, no contract or schema changed).

findings.defect: The registry test still listed the draft tools before H7c, H9b and H11b.
findings.scenario: test_every_tool_is_registered_once_and_well_formed failed on main with eight tools it did not know.
findings.cause: The packages that added the tools did not update the test's expected set.
findings.fix: The expected set names every draft tool with the package that added it.

outcome: Home's model reads what an answer, a brief or an export computed and never its values; the period of a business question is the one the person meant; the new Home code works on pandas 3 as the rest of the repository does. The query engine imports first in any program, and the registry test knows every draft tool.
lessons: A tool that returns nothing still tells the model everything if the chat history carries the person's view.
A check written as dtype == object is a pandas 2 check.
risks: Any new message that shows table values needs its model_text; the new data-limit test covers answers only through query_data.
